descriptions.d18d_camera_view_matrix_8015aa04: Build the camera view matrix: get the right/up/forward basis from 0x8015a6f0, store it transposed into rows 0-2 with w = 0, and set row 3 to the negated dot products of the camera position (+4) with each axis and w = 1. Owns its float literal pool (0.0, 1.0).
